class.name: OcgGCMakemirror
class.brief_description: This class implements elementary construction algorithms for a symmetrical transformation in 3D space about a point, axis or plane. The result is a Geom_Transformation transformation. A MakeMirror object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
